cropAdvisories.advisorySummary: Comprehensive precision advisory generated for North Delta Valley - Plot A. Calibrated for 6.4 pH, 160 ppm Nitrogen, and 40 mm seasonal rainfall. Employs split-nitrogen application and targeted physiological stage management.

actionPlan.summary: Comprehensive precision advisory generated for North Delta Valley - Plot A. Calibrated for 6.4 pH, 160 ppm Nitrogen, and 40 mm seasonal rainfall. Employs split-nitrogen application and targeted physiological stage management.
soilAmendments: OPTIMAL pH RANGE: Soil pH 6.40 is well-buffered for active macro- and micro-nutrient cation exchange.

LOW NITROGEN INTERVENTION (160 ppm): Initiate 3-split nitrogen schedule: 35% basal, 40% active vegetative top-dressing, and 25% boot-stage foliar application. Supplement with 8 tonnes enriched Farmyard Manure (FYM).

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Light daily drip pulses (1.5-2.0 hours) maintaining 80% field capacity.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Basal placement of DAP + MOP with 40% primary Nitrogen.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor for seed rot, damping-off (Pythium spp.), and cutworms in first 14 days.

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Irrigate at 18-21 day intervals or when soil tensiometer reads > 45 kPa.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: First top dressing: Broadcast 45 kg Neem-Coated Urea prior to scheduled irrigation.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Scout foliage twice weekly for stem borers, leaf miners, and foliar blight spots.

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: CRITICAL MOISTURE WINDOW: Strictly avoid water deficit stress during floret anthesis.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Foliar nutrition: 1.0% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) + 0.2% Boron (Solubor) spray.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor for aphids, thrips, and head blight; spray neem-oil bio-pesticide if threshold breached.

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Terminal drying: Discontinue all supplemental irrigation 10-14 days prior to harvest.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: No further chemical fertilizers. Enable natural nutrient remobilization to grain.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Check moisture percentage (12-14%); schedule combine harvester during clear dry weather.

cropAdvisories.advisorySummary: Comprehensive precision advisory generated for North Delta Valley - Plot A. Calibrated for 5.2 pH, 110 ppm Nitrogen, and 65 mm seasonal rainfall. Employs split-nitrogen application and targeted physiological stage management.

actionPlan.summary: Comprehensive precision advisory generated for North Delta Valley - Plot A. Calibrated for 5.2 pH, 110 ppm Nitrogen, and 65 mm seasonal rainfall. Employs split-nitrogen application and targeted physiological stage management.
soilAmendments: CRITICAL ACIDITY CORRECTION: Soil pH is 5.20 (< 5.5). Broadcast 1105 kg Agricultural Liming Material (Agricultural Limestone / Dolomite CaCO3/MgCO3) per acre 3-4 weeks prior to sowing to unlock phosphorus bioavailability.

LOW NITROGEN INTERVENTION (110 ppm): Initiate 3-split nitrogen schedule: 35% basal, 40% active vegetative top-dressing, and 25% boot-stage foliar application. Supplement with 8 tonnes enriched Farmyard Manure (FYM).
PHOSPHORUS DEFICIENCY (18 ppm): Incorporate 50-60 kg/acre Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP 18:46:0) placed 5cm below seed furrow for vigorous early rooting.
POTASSIUM ENHANCEMENT (140 ppm): Apply 30-40 kg Muriate of Potash (MOP 0:0:60) per acre to fortify plant vascular tissue against drought and stem lodging.

lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Pre-sowing lime incorporation + basal split: 35% Nitrogen, 100% P2O5, 100% K2O.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor for seed rot, damping-off (Pythium spp.), and cutworms in first 14 days.

lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor for aphids, thrips, and head blight; spray neem-oil bio-pesticide if threshold breached.

cropAdvisories.advisorySummary: Optimal sowing window recommended for late Rabi cycle. Soil pH (6.8) is in prime neutral range. Balanced basal NPK recommended with second split during Crown Root Initiation.

actionPlan.summary: Optimal sowing window recommended for late Rabi cycle. Soil pH (6.8) is in prime neutral range. Balanced basal NPK recommended with second split during Crown Root Initiation.
soilAmendments: Apply 10 tonnes Farmyard Manure (FYM) per acre prior to primary tillage
Basal dose of 50kg DAP + 25kg MOP per acre
Top dressing with 40kg Urea at 21 days after sowing (CRI stage)

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Light pre-sowing soaking followed by first crucial irrigation at Day 21 (CRI).
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Basal application: 50% N + 100% P + 100% K during final seedbed preparation.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Inspect for termite attack and pre-emergence weed flushes (Phalaris minor).

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Second irrigation at active tillering (Day 40-45). Maintain uniform moisture.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: First top dressing: 25% Nitrogen (Urea) broadcast immediately prior to irrigation.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor for yellow rust pustules on lower leaves; install yellow sticky traps.

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Critical irrigation at heading stage. Avoid water stress to prevent floret abortion.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Final foliar spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) to enhance grain filling.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Scout for wheat aphids (Sitobion avenae); threshold 10 aphids per earhead.

lifecyclePhases.irrigationSchedule: Last light irrigation at dough stage. Discontinue irrigation 12 days before harvest.
lifecyclePhases.fertilizationAction: Zero fertilization. Allow natural senescence and nutrient remobilization.
lifecyclePhases.pestSurveillance: Monitor grain moisture; target 12-14% moisture content for mechanical combine harvest.

economicOutlook.recommendedMarketWindow: Early April peak procurement with MSP window

symptomsObserved: Concentric dark rings creating target-board foliar lesions
Yellow chlorotic halos surrounding irregular brown spots
Premature senescence of lower canopy leaves

treatments.chemicalIntervention: Foliar application of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/liter or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/liter.
treatments.organicAlternative: Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide (Serenade) foliar spray @ 5ml/liter or 5% cold-pressed Neem seed kernel extract.
treatments.culturalPreventativeMeasures: Implement 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops. Maintain drip irrigation to prevent foliar wetting.

pathologyScans.diagnosisLabel: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV) & Whitefly Infestation

symptomsObserved: Upward and downward curling of upper leaves
Thickening of veins on underside of foliage

treatments.chemicalIntervention: Foliar application of Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 250g/acre or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 400ml/acre to suppress vector whitefly population.
treatments.organicAlternative: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or 1500 ppm Azadirachtin @ 5ml/liter of water with sticker agent; release Chrysoperla carnea predators.
treatments.culturalPreventativeMeasures: Eradicate alternate weed hosts (Abutilon indicum, Parthenium hysterophorus) along field bunds. Install yellow sticky traps (15 traps/acre).
